title: Arrival
intent: He arrives and enters, slowly, without rushing the house.
emotionalTurn: He sits with the house instead of avoiding it.
openingImage: walks up the long dirt drive toward an empty house
closingImage: sits down by the window and rests his hands on his knees

shots.action: walks up the long dirt drive toward an empty house
shots.location: a dirt drive at golden hour
shots.soundMood: wind in dry grass, distant birds
shots.lockedLookBlock: Desaturated late-light realism, warm practical lamps against cold blue-grey daylight, muted earth palette of rust, faded denim, worn wood and grey sky, locked-off camera with slow push-ins only, 35mm normal lens feel, soft natural grain, no drone shots, no saturated color.

lockedCharacterBlocks.The Man: a weathered man in his late 60s with short grey hair, a lined face, a worn brown work jacket over a faded denim shirt, dark trousers and scuffed boots, moving slowly and deliberately

shots.background: Foreground: dry grass and dirt at the drive's edge. Midground: the man walking up the drive. Deep background: the empty house at the drive's end, dark windows, golden-hour sky behind it.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-4s): man enters frame at the drive's far end, walking slowly. Beat 2 (4-7s): he continues up the drive, pace unchanging. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): he pauses briefly, looking at the house, then continues, hold on the pause.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, so the man's slow approach and the house's stillness read against each other, extreme wide framing with drive leading to house.
shots.lighting: Golden-hour sun low behind the house, warm light on the drive, house in shadow, long shadows across the dirt.
shots.focus: Deep focus: man, drive, and house all sharp.
shots.motion: Subject motion: slow, deliberate walk, no hurry. Background motion: dry grass moving in wind. Camera still — the man moves through a still world.
shots.extras: No background performers; the drive and house are empty, which is the point of the arrival.
shots.loreNotes: House rule: empty but kept, dust not ruin. Man rule: moves slowly and deliberately, never hurries. Light rule: arrival at golden hour.

departments.production-design: Drive in s01 and s24 must be the same drive, same side, so the rhyme reads
departments.costume: Boots dusted from the drive, jacket worn, no change of clothes
departments.sound: No music; wind in dry grass, distant birds only

shots.action: opens the gate and steps through, closing it behind him
shots.soundMood: gate latch click, gravel under boots
shots.lockedLookBlock: Desaturated late-light realism, warm practical lamps against cold blue-grey daylight, muted earth palette of rust, faded denim, worn wood and grey sky, locked-off camera with slow push-ins only, 35mm normal lens feel, soft natural grain, no drone shots, no saturated color.

lockedCharacterBlocks.The Man: a weathered man in his late 60s with short grey hair, a lined face, a worn brown work jacket over a faded denim shirt, dark trousers and scuffed boots, moving slowly and deliberately

shots.background: Foreground: weathered garden gate and gatepost, paint worn. Midground: the man at the gate. Deep background: garden path and house porch, golden light fading.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): man reaches the gate and stops. Beat 2 (3-7s): he opens the gate, steps through, and closes it behind him — one continuous threshold action, not three separate actions. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): he stands on the house side of the gate, hand still on the latch, hold on the crossing.
shots.cameraChoreography: Push-in: from a wide shot at 4 metres to a closer framing at 2 metres, ending with the man and the gate centred and the porch behind him.
shots.lighting: Golden-hour light fading, warm on the gate wood, porch in soft shadow, no artificial light yet.
shots.focus: Focus on the man and the gate latch, garden and porch slightly soft behind.
shots.motion: Subject motion: stop, open, step, close, stand — a single threshold sequence. Background motion: garden grass in wind. Camera pushes in steadily, then holds.
shots.extras: No background performers; the garden is empty.
shots.loreNotes: Threshold rule: the gate is a crossing, not a door to be opened and forgotten. Closing it behind him matters — he is shutting himself in with the past, deliberately.

departments.production-design: Gate is the same gate as s19, but at dusk in s02 and in morning light in s19
departments.costume: Jacket and boots unchanged from s01
departments.sound: Gate latch click, gravel under boots, no music

shots.action: crosses the porch and pauses at the front door

shots.background: Foreground: wooden porch boards and a porch rail. Midground: the man crossing the porch. Deep background: front door, closed, with a porch light fixture beside it, unlit.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-4s): man crosses the porch slowly. Beat 2 (4-7s): he reaches the front door and pauses, hand near the handle but not turning it. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): he stands at the door, hesitating, hold on the hesitation before entering.
shots.cameraChoreography: Tracking: camera tracks with the man across the porch at his pace, ending in a medium shot with the door beside him.
shots.lighting: Late golden light on the porch boards, door in shadow, porch light fixture unlit — the light that will be switched on in s22 is not yet on.
shots.focus: Focus on the man, door slightly soft behind him.
shots.motion: Subject motion: slow walk, then stillness at the door. Background motion: wind in the garden beyond the porch. Camera tracks, then stops with him.
shots.extras: No background performers; the porch is empty.
shots.loreNotes: Man rule: slow and deliberate, never hurries. Porch light rule: unlit until s22, when it is switched on and left on.

departments.production-design: Porch boards, rail, and door must match s21-s22's porch

shots.action: enters the hallway and stands still, listening to the house
shots.location: a hallway in an empty house
shots.emotionalBeat: the house is present, not ruined
shots.soundMood: room tone, a clock ticking far off
shots.lockedLookBlock: Desaturated late-light realism, warm practical lamps against cold blue-grey daylight, muted earth palette of rust, faded denim, worn wood and grey sky, locked-off camera with slow push-ins only, 35mm normal lens feel, soft natural grain, no drone shots, no saturated color.

shots.background: Foreground: hallway floorboards and a runner rug, worn. Midground: the man standing in the hallway. Deep background: hallway stretching to the kitchen at the far end, a clock ticking somewhere off-frame.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): man enters the hallway and stops. Beat 2 (3-7s): he stands still, listening, head slightly turned. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): he remains still, hold on listening — the house is present, not ruined, and he is hearing it again.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, wide framing with the hallway's length visible, so stillness reads as listening, not as a frozen frame.
shots.lighting: Late light through a hallway window, warm on the floorboards, rest of the hallway in soft shadow, no artificial light.
shots.focus: Deep focus: man, hallway, and kitchen doorway all readable.
shots.motion: Subject motion: enter, then stillness. Background motion: light moving slightly, dust in a sunbeam. Camera still — stillness is the action.
shots.extras: No background performers; the house is empty.
shots.loreNotes: House rule: empty but kept, dust not ruin. Layout rule: front door at one end, kitchen at the other, workshop door off the side.

departments.production-design: Hallway layout fixed: door, kitchen, workshop door in the same positions in every hallway shot
departments.sound: Room tone, clock ticking far off, no music

shots.action: stands in the kitchen, hand on a worn countertop
shots.lockedLookBlock: Desaturated late-light realism, warm practical lamps against cold blue-grey daylight, muted earth palette of rust, faded denim, worn wood and grey sky, locked-off camera with slow push-ins only, 35mm normal lens feel, soft natural grain, no drone shots, no saturated color.

shots.background: Foreground: kitchen countertop edge, worn patch visible. Midground: the man standing in the kitchen, hand on the countertop. Deep background: kitchen window with late light, faint birds outside the window.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): man stands in the kitchen, hand finding the countertop. Beat 2 (3-7s): his hand rests on the worn patch, fingers still. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): he looks out of the window, hold on memory surfacing without a flashback.
shots.cameraChoreography: Push-in: from a medium shot at 3 metres to a closer framing at 1.5 metres, ending on his hand on the countertop and his face in profile.
shots.lighting: Late light through the kitchen window, warm on the countertop, man's face in soft side light, no artificial light.
shots.focus: Rack focus from the countertop wear to the man's face in beat 3.
shots.motion: Subject motion: hand finding, resting, looking — small, deliberate moves. Background motion: light through the window, birds outside. Camera pushes in slowly.
shots.extras: No background performers; the kitchen is empty.
shots.loreNotes: Object rule: the countertop wear is a continuity anchor — same worn patch, same side, in every kitchen shot. Memory rule: memory surfaces, it is not shown as a flashback.

departments.production-design: Countertop worn patch must be the same patch in every kitchen shot
departments.costume: Jacket sleeve on the countertop, no change of clothes
departments.sound: Kettle silence, faint birds outside, no music

shots.action: looks at a faded photograph, then looks away, not smiling
shots.location: a photograph on a hallway wall
shots.lockedLookBlock: Desaturated late-light realism, warm practical lamps against cold blue-grey daylight, muted earth palette of rust, faded denim, worn wood and grey sky, locked-off camera with slow push-ins only, 35mm normal lens feel, soft natural grain, no drone shots, no saturated color.

lockedCharacterBlocks.The Man: a weathered man in his late 60s with short grey hair, a lined face, a worn brown work jacket over a faded denim shirt, dark trousers and scuffed boots, moving slowly and deliberately

shots.background: Foreground: hallway wall edge, faded wallpaper. Midground: the faded photograph on the wall. Deep background: hallway stretching away, out of focus, so the photograph is the only readable object.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): man looks at the photograph. Beat 2 (3-7s): he looks away, not smiling, face still. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): hold on his face after looking away — grief without performance, no tear, no smile, no explanation.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, close framing on the photograph and the man's face beside it, so looking and looking away read as two beats.
shots.lighting: Late light on the hallway wall, photograph in soft light, man's face in shadow, no artificial light.
shots.focus: Shallow focus: photograph sharp in beat 1, man's face sharp in beat 2, never both sharp at once — the audience cannot read the photograph and his face at the same time, by design.
shots.motion: Subject motion: look, look away, hold. Background motion: none. Camera still — the beat is in the eyes, not in movement.
shots.extras: No background performers; the hallway is empty.
shots.loreNotes: Photograph rule: faded, looked at once here, then looked away from, not smiling. Never taken down, never shown as a readable image, never explained.

departments.production-design: Photograph on the same hallway wall as the mirror in s15, but a different wall section
departments.sound: Silence, held — silence is the cue, not an absence

shots.action: watches sunlight move across an empty room
shots.location: an empty room in late light
shots.soundMood: soft wind through a cracked window

shots.background: Foreground: empty room floorboards and a window sill. Midground: sunlight moving across the empty room. Deep background: far wall with a window, late light through it, room otherwise empty.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): man stands at the room's edge, watching. Beat 2 (3-7s): sunlight moves across the floor, visibly, as time passes in the shot. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): hold on the empty room with the light moved — time passing, visibly, is the beat.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, wide framing with the whole room and its window visible, so the light's movement is measurable against the room.
shots.lighting: Late light through the window, moving across the floor during the shot, room otherwise in soft shadow.
shots.focus: Deep focus: room, window, and light patch all sharp.
shots.motion: Subject motion: man almost still, watching. Background motion: sunlight moving across the floor — the only large movement, and it is the point. Camera still.
shots.extras: No background performers; the room is empty.
shots.loreNotes: Light rule: time of day progresses — arrival at golden hour, reckoning in late light. Light moving in this shot is time passing, not a lighting change for its own sake.

departments.production-design: Empty room must be genuinely empty — no furniture introduced to fill the frame
departments.costume: Man at the room's edge, jacket unchanged
departments.sound: Soft wind through a cracked window, no music

shots.location: a kitchen chair by a window

shots.background: Foreground: kitchen chair by the window, wooden, worn. Midground: the man sitting by the window. Deep background: window with late light and garden beyond, out of focus.
shots.choreography: Beat 1 (0-3s): man sits down by the window, slowly. Beat 2 (3-7s): he rests his hands on his knees, still. Beat 3, payoff (7-10s): hold on sitting still — accepting the stillness, not waiting for something to happen.
shots.cameraChoreography: Locked-off: camera does not move, medium framing with the chair, the man, and the window in one composition.
shots.lighting: Late light through the window on the man's face and hands, chair in warm light, rest of the kitchen in shadow.
shots.focus: Focus on the man's hands on his knees, chair and window slightly soft.
shots.motion: Subject motion: sit, rest, hold — the smallest possible moves. Background motion: light through the window, garden beyond. Camera still.
shots.extras: No background performers; the kitchen is empty.
shots.loreNotes: Man rule: slow and deliberate. Stillness rule: sitting still is an action in this film, not a pause between actions.
